Q5651.reason: The 'as is' clause disclaims implied warranties but cannot override the express description of the car as a 1964 model, so the seller is likely liable.

Q5672.reason: Acquittal based on self-defense means the killing was justified and no crime occurred, whereas insanity and diminished capacity are personal excuses that don't absolve the instigator.

Q8537.reason: The definition of punishment should be value-neutral so that its justification can be argued separately rather than settled by definition.
